integrity: All-size stationarity and current are proved by transition-kernel balance and irreducibility. Finite symbolic and linear-system checks are supplementary; the stated originality assessment is bibliographic rather than a proof of universal novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two hard-core particles on a ring of at least three sites, one moving defect with deterministic positive dwell time and positive symmetric exit rates; zero bulk and incoming-to-defect rates. No result for larger particle count, bulk hopping or random defect dynamics.
title: Exact two-particle stationary law and backward current for a moving-defect exclusion ring
